name: [2x🍪] Roblox Cookie Clicker
desc:
🍪👆 Have fun!

👆 • Tap/Click to make cookies, then buy things that make cookies for you. Then tap/click some more!  (crazy right?)
🏆 • Hundreds of upgrades and achievements to unlock. 
🗿 • Leaderboards to show how your competitors are doing. 

⭐You can ascend in the settings. It will tell you how much cookies you need before you can ascend.⭐

This is simply just a fan-made version of the original Cookie Clicker.
🫂 All updates/changes are suggested by you guys! 🫂

(To leave an update idea, go in the settings menu and click "Submit Update Idea")
💡Feel free to give your thoughts or go crazy with the ideas you have for this game! 💡

Have fun! Credits: Orteil, Toby's Music and you guys!

Tags: Cookie, Cookie Clicker, Simulator, Tapping, Clicking, Idle, Idle Game, Roblox Cookie Clicker, Clicker Simulator
